about_the_game:
While traveling west your caravan discovers a cult that has seemingly existed in the desert for hundreds of years. Who are they? Who or what is their god? And most importantly, can you and your caravan survive their attempt to push back the western expansion?
---

In Circle the Wagons: Prima Septimana you take control of an unnamed cowboy struggling to establish an encampment in hostile lands. Build your camp with turrets, traps, and other buildings while also upgrading your cowboy with new weapons, skills, and unique perks to defend against wave after wave of enemies. The larger your camp gets the more travelers will join and help defend against the mysterious cult.

Prima Septimana is a short and small game with unique gameplay in a Gothic Western setting.

content_descriptors.notes: CTW features violence and blood depicted in retro pixel art.
